svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut one 95 mm length of 40 x 20 x 1.5 tube; square ends. It stands

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 40 mm tall, 20 mm front to back.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four 6.5 mm holes front to back through both 40 mm faces:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: clip holes 12.5 mm from each end, 12.5 mm up from the bottom;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: shank holes at mid-length (47.5 mm), 10 and 30 mm up from the bottom.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: between the rails, its bottom flush with the rail bottoms and its

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: front face 161 mm behind the drive axle (241 mm from the rail front),

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: held by two corner clips on its rear face. It carries the opener

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: shank on its rear face; the drive wheel lugs pass 19 mm in front.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: square to the rails; the top stands 15 mm above the rails.
